title: Jensen Huang’s reported affair was ‘most expensive sex since Helen of Troy’, US senator says
en: John Kennedy looks to Trump leaders as he asks how China evidently bypassed export controls for Nvidia’s top AI chips Invoking Greek mythology, US senator John Kennedy has characterized former Nvidia chief executive officer Jensen Huang ’s reported affair with a suspected Chinese spy as “the most expensive sex since Helen of Troy”. The Louisiana Republican’s allusion to the legendary figure whose desirability was such that it caused the mythic Trojan war came during an interview on NBC’s Meet the Press on Sunday. Host Kristen Welker asked Kennedy, known for his colloquialisms, if US national security was put at risk by Huang’s affair, given the position his company’s chips have occupied at the forefront of the artificial intelligence boom.
